headline: Observe the Hunt.
Claim the Range.
hero.subheadline: Across four world ranges — Serengeti, Bengal, Patagonia, and Taiga — apex predators still hold their ground. Collect cards, build observer decks, and trade on a quiet market before rival territory closes the range.

paragraphs: Every range remembers who hunts last. A force called Strike presses to claim territory, while Stamina holds the line — the endurance that lets savanna prides coordinate, delta tigers ambush, ridge pumas stalk, and boreal wolves patrol.
As Strike moves across the board, predators grow restless. Observers must not only win their matches, but keep these ranges coherent before the last quiet hunt dissolves into chaos.
